name: redbook
description: The redbtn CRM — clients, contacts, notes, and interactions

runtime.//: RUNTIME env lives in the RedRun workspace appConfig.env. redsecrets is BUILD-time only in RedRun, so these must be set there, not as build secrets. Values are intentionally not committed.

notes: NODE_ENV must NOT be set to production in appConfig — it breaks npm ci devDependencies during the image build. The Dockerfile sets it in the runner stage only.

JWT_SECRET is the SHARED ecosystem secret accounts.redbtn.io signs red_session with. redBook only verifies it. A value stored with surrounding quotes fails verification; loadRuntimeConfig strips them defensively.
Merging to the tracked branch IS the deploy once autoDeploy is on.
